The image is ready.

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the one view in `workspace.dsl` (`SystemContext`), rendered as a C4 system-context diagram:
- **Patron** (person) → **Library** (software system), labeled *"Browses the catalogue through"* with the **HTTPS** technology
- Standard C4-PlantUML color scheme, title, and a legend

A note on format: I produced **SVG rather than PNG** because this environment has no way to rasterize — there's no external internet (DNS fails for all public hosts, so the PlantUML/Mermaid web services are unreachable), and no local renderer or package manager (no `plantuml`/`java`/`node`/`python`/`graphviz`/`chromium`/`imagemagick`, no `apt`). The only rendering-capable service here is the Structurizr MCP, which exports to text (PlantUML/Mermaid/C4-PlantUML) but not images. So I authored the SVG directly from the view's exact elements and relationships (verified well-formed).

If you'd prefer PNG, I can convert it if you can provide either internet access or a local rasterizer (e.g. `rsvg-convert`, `inkscape`, `chromium`, or `plantuml.jar` + `java`). Otherwise the SVG opens in any browser or image viewer.
